entries.21d4d56c77534681: This segment sells foods such as processed foods, daily-delivered goods, confectionery, beverages and alcoholic beverages. Sales by product for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥131,444 million.
entries.57aeeecf51ca9296: This segment sells daily necessities such as hair care products, oral care products, detergents, paper products, pet supplies and childcare products. Sales by product for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥77,413 million.
entries.79d4f3f7e6c40979: This business operates drugstores that sell pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, foodstuffs, alcoholic beverages and the like, and drugstores with attached pharmacies whose main business is dispensing prescriptions. The company defines stores with a sales floor area of 400 tsubo or more as “mega drugstores” and mainly operates large suburban stores with sales floor areas of 400 to 1,000 tsubo. The number of stores is 386, of which 160 have an attached pharmacy (as of March 15, 2026). The company group has a single segment, so amounts by business segment are not disclosed.
entries.8f44097d5a22272e: A drugstore chain headquartered in Oyama City, Tochigi Prefecture, operating mega drugstores with a sales floor of 400 tsubo or more and drugstores with an attached dispensing pharmacy.
entries.94977d003947becd: This segment handles pharmaceuticals such as cold medicine, stomach medicine, various vitamin supplements, eye drops, wound medicine, health foods and nursing care products, and prescription dispensing. Sales by product for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥51,418 million.
